promptTemplates._note: Use {subject}, {mood}, {composition}, {system_era} as template variables. {system_era} comes from systems/<system>/system.json 'era' field.
promptTemplates.ackegard: Create a black and white ink illustration in the style of Swedish fantasy illustrator Håkan Ackegård. The subject is: {subject}. Setting: {system_era}. Use traditional pen and ink technique with detailed crosshatching, high contrast with dramatic shadows, Nordic atmosphere, and intricate line work. Mood: {mood}. Composition: {composition}.
promptTemplates.bergting: Create a stylized graphic novel illustration in the style of Swedish artist Peter Bergting (The Portent, Domovoi). The subject is: {subject}. Setting: {system_era}. Use bold, dynamic linework with heavy blacks, graphic novel aesthetic, Nordic mythology influences, limited muted color palette, and moody atmospheric backgrounds. Mood: {mood}. Composition: {composition}.
promptTemplates.egerkrans: Create a watercolor-style illustration in the manner of Swedish illustrator Johan Egerkrans (Nordiska väsen, Drakar). The subject is: {subject}. Setting: {system_era}. Use atmospheric watercolor technique with soft edges, Scandinavian folklore inspiration, mystical ethereal mood, muted earth tones, naturalistic creature design, and fairy tale book illustration quality. Mood: {mood}. Composition: {composition}.
